About Fortimesh

Strength that secures your future.

Based in Kimironko, Kigali, we supply steel, gabion solutions and essential construction materials for projects shaping communities across Rwanda.

Our company

Reliable materials.
Practical service.

FORTIMESH AND STEELS RWANDA LTD is a Kigali-based construction materials and steel supplier located at KG 667 Street, Kimironko. We partner with civil and building contractors, structural engineers, real estate developers, public institutions and private homebuilders across Rwanda.

Our core strength lies in bridging heavy civil and structural steel requirements—such as double-twisted gabion baskets, chain-link fencing, deformed reinforcement bars and structural hollow/open sections—with everyday building services and waterproofing supplies like Sika Hydrofuge.

Whether your procurement starts from an engineer’s bar bending schedule, a tender bill of quantities or an urgent site requisition, our sales team provides clear specifications, competitive unit pricing and dependable delivery coordination.

What we supply

Four divisions.
Seven product families.

01

Gabion & wire

Hexagonal gabion baskets, chain-link fencing, barbed wire and tying wire for civil works and perimeter security.

  • Gabion mesh
  • Steel wire products
02

Steel & reinforcement

Deformed high-yield rebar, BRC mesh, hollow sections, I-beams and steel pipes for concrete and structural frames.

  • Reinforcement materials
  • Structural steel
03

Building services

Pressure plumbing pipework, drainage systems, electrical cables, conduits and distribution hardware.

  • Plumbing materials
  • Electrical supplies
04

Construction essentials

Waterproofing admixtures (including Sika solutions), site hardware, fasteners and general building supplies.

  • General construction materials

How we work with you

From schedule to site delivery.

  1. Step 01

    Send your schedule

    Share your bill of quantities, bar bending schedule, drawings or itemised material list via our quote tool or WhatsApp.

  2. Step 02

    Receive itemised pricing

    Our Kimironko sales desk verifies stock availability, technical grades and unit pricing for your exact specification.

  3. Step 03

    Coordinate site delivery

    Collect from our Kigali stockyard on KG 667 Street or schedule direct dispatch to your project site anywhere in Rwanda.
